text: Noticing that something is off takes human eyes. Tell a nurse.
The AI logged the number. It never noticed the sad little face.
SIGN
Sign the form saying a child is well enough for school.
Someone must answer for a health sign-off. A tool cannot.
The AI signed 'Healthy' for a child it never met. Who is to blame?
Count the cans, noodles and coffee sachets left on the shelves.
Counting stock is the same job over and over. AI does it fast.
Aling Nena counted every can herself. The line grew long.
SALES
Add up today's sales from the notebook.
Adding long columns is quick. Compare the total with the cash box.
The notebook was added by hand, then added again. Slow work.
PRICES
Make a neat price list for the store board.
A tidy list is an easy draft. Read it before you hang it up.
The list was lettered by hand, with crossed-out prices. Hours!
REORDER
List what to reorder from the supplier this week.
Turning sales patterns into a shopping list is a pattern job.
It was worked out on scrap paper while the store sat shut.
Translate the sign 'No credit today' into Hiligaynon.
AI drafts fast. A neighbour who speaks it well checks the tone.
It was written slowly, asking around for words. It took ages.
Write a short text to tell regular customers about the new rice price.
A short, plain notice is an easy draft. Read it, then send it.
LOAD
Look for double entries in the e-load notebook.
Spotting repeats in a long list is a pattern job. Check what it finds.
Page after page, line by line. Her eyes hurt and the store waited.
DELIVER
Make the delivery calendar: which day each supplier comes.
Fitting days into a calendar is a pattern job. Read it before use.
The calendar was drawn by hand and redrawn twice. A morning gone.
EXPIRY
List the items whose expiry dates fall this month.
Sorting by date is quick for AI. Then you check the real shelf.
Every label was read by hand, one can at a time. Slow going.
A regular customer is scared because her child is sick. Comfort her.
She needs a caring person, and a push to the health center.
The AI said 'Your feelings are being processed. Please hold.'
MEDS?
A customer asks which medicine to take for a long cough.
Only a health worker can advise on medicine. Point her to the center.
The AI named a medicine from a list. Nobody was accountable.
UTANG
Ka Tonyo asks for credit again. Yes, or no?
You know Ka Tonyo and his family. No tool has that knowledge.
The AI said 'Credit denied' to a customer of twenty years. Ouch.
ARGUE
Two customers argue about who was first in line.
Settling a quarrel takes fairness and a calm, friendly face.
The AI said 'You are both wrong.' Now both were angry.
CHAT
Chat with Lola Pining, who visits just to talk.
The visit is the point. She comes for a person, not for biscuits.
The AI replied 'Please state your purchase.' Lola walked away.
UPSET
A customer says her canned fish smelled bad. Hear her out.
Saying sorry and fixing it fairly is a judgement call.
The AI sent 'No refunds.' The customer told the whole barangay.
WELCOME
A new neighbour is shy and lost. Make her welcome.
A warm hello makes a neighbour. A message cannot do it for you.
The AI sent a coupon code. She still did not know where to go.
HELPER
Your helper is late and tired again. Talk kindly, then decide.
You know what is behind it. Kindness and fairness are yours.
The AI sent 'Warning 1 of 3' at midnight. The helper quit.
QR?
A stranger says, 'Scan my QR to get paid more.' Accept?
Judging a possible scam is your job. When unsure, say no.
The AI scanned it at once. The e-wallet was empty by lunch.

Water containers pop up. The AI camera draws a box on what it thinks is a larva, with how sure it is (a percentage). Real larvae wriggle. Seeds, leaf bits and raisins lie still.

With WHACK chosen, tap a boxed larva to whack it, or tap a larva with no box to add it. With REJECT chosen, tap a box around something that is not a larva. Keyboard: arrows pick an object, up chooses Whack, down chooses Reject, Space or Enter uses it.
Tap DONE when you have fixed everything. Finishing early with no larva left gives a time bonus. A wrong whack or reject costs 20 points and your streak.
Every larva left in the water when time is up grows into a mosquito and costs a heart. You have 5 hearts, and each new container is quicker than the last.
The two meters grade the AI. Precision: of its boxes, how many were right. Catch rate: of the real larvae, how many got a box.
Mosquito watch time!
Dengue mosquitoes grow from larvae in standing water. Today the AI camera helps you find them in drums, tires and cans.
AI makes two mistakes
AI cameras can spot larvae, but they make two kinds of mistakes: a box around a seed, and a larva with no box at all.
Whack real larvae, reject wrong boxes, and tap a larva the AI missed to add it. Watch the precision and catch rate meters.
Clean water, new mosquitoes
Dengue mosquitoes breed in clean standing water. Cover, clean and empty your containers every week.
Trust the AI camera as a helper. Your own eyes make the final call.
When should I trust it? I trust the AI camera as a helper, and my own eyes make the final call.

A customer orders an answer. Add the prompt ingredients the order asks for, then press COOK before the timer ends.
Tap or click an ingredient to put it in the pot (tap it again to take it out), or drag it into the pot. With the keyboard use the arrow keys, then Space or Enter.
Each part the customer names needs its ingredient: audience, language, length, format and role. Health questions also need Cite sources and Say if unsure.
Missing ingredients serve a funny wrong dish and cost a heart. Adding things nobody asked for clutters the dish.
Faster cooking earns a speed bonus, and health orders earn tips. You have 3 hearts, and orders get quicker and never repeat.
Welcome to my kitchen!
Customers order answers from an AI chatbot, and you cook up the prompt. Do not worry, nobody gets food poisoning. Just funny dishes.
A good prompt is a good recipe
Say who the answer is for, which language, how long, what format and what role. A clear recipe makes a clear dish.
Tap or drag ingredients into the pot, then press COOK before the timer ends. On a keyboard, use the arrows and Enter.
Health questions need extras
For health questions, ask the AI to cite sources and to say when it is unsure. Both go in the pot.
Trust answers that show their sources, and check them with a health worker.
When should I trust it? When an answer shows its sources and admits when it is unsure, and I still check it with a health worker.
